title: simulator names sidecar (<result>.names)
description: A JSON file written beside a simulation result as `<result>.names` (result.raw -> result.raw.names). It maps a simulator's signal names to the DSPF's branch currents `R:1`, with the sign that turns the saved current into the current from the resistor's first node to its second: 1 or -1. HSPICE, Xyce and ngspice name currents i(xi0.rm1), I(XI0:RM1), @r.xi0.rm1[i] ...; keys are matched without regard to case. Without the sidecar those names do not match the DSPF and the result reads as holding none of the net's currents. `emir simulate` also records how the result was made: the simulator, its version (when it ran here) and `sim_args`, which the on-site verification (`emir verify-sim`) is keyed on; for Spectre, whose names need no map, the sidecar beside the result directory holds only those (an empty `map`).
